### Watered Down Wine
Author: Stuart Briscoe
Site: Crosswalk.com
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/one-year-devotions-for-men/watered-down-wine-one-year-devotions-for-men-january-3.html
Passage: Isaiah 1:22
Points:
- While Christ famously turned water into wine, ancient Jerusalem did the reverse by turning pure silver into slag and fine wine into water.
- The city's spiritual decline was not instantaneous, but stemmed from gradual compromises, unaddressed corruption, and a breakdown of justice among leaders.
- God promised decisive intervention to melt away the dross and restore wise judges and righteous living to His people.
- The Lord addresses personal backsliding with the same purifying discipline, exposing hidden compromise to restore spiritual health.
- Divine discipline is restorative rather than vindictive, promising renewed purity and redemption to all who genuinely repent.
